candidates.xgb_D: continued XGBoost study using Morgan 1024 plus five RDKit descriptors
candidates.lgbm_D: continued LightGBM study using Morgan 1024 plus five RDKit descriptors

tuning.objective: macro Average Precision over all 109 labels
tuning.fairness_rule: equal cumulative active tuning time for XGBoost and LightGBM

robustness.selection_metric: mean macro Average Precision across repetitions

threshold_selection.source: mean repeated grouped out-of-fold validation probabilities

test_access: after all continued candidates are compared by repeated grouped CV, both algorithm selections are frozen, and any selected extended candidates are fitted on all training data
confirmatory_status: exploratory symmetric tuning continuation after grouped-v3 test inspection; grouped-v3 remains the primary XGBoost-LightGBM comparison
